name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students
benefit:
The rate of fellowship for JRF and SRF is at par with the UGC fellowship, presently the rates are as follows:

- **Fellowship in Science Humanities and Social Science:**  ₹ 31,000/- p.m. for initial two years (JRF), and ₹ 35,000/- pm. for remaining tenure (SRF)- **Fellowship in Engineering & Technology:** ₹ 31,000/- p.m. for initial two years (JRF), and ₹ 35,000/- pm. for remaining tenure (SRF
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a part of one of the minority communities (Buddhist, Christian, Jain, Muslim, Sikh, or Zoroastrian (Parsi)).
1. Applicant must qualify the UGC-NET or Joint CSIR-UGC NET examination.
1. If  applicant does not complete his/her research work during the period of fellowship shall not be eligible to apply again under this scheme.
1. If applicant completely or partially availed any fellowship earlier shall also not be eligible for fellowship under this scheme.
1. Employees of any university, college, educational institution, or central, state, or union territory government are not eligible for fellowships, even if they are on study leave or end of life (EOL) leave to pursue an M.Phil. or Ph.D. course
